newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta exchange suspends Super Mitory.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta exchange suspends Super Mitory.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading in small-capitalised Indonesian footwear manufacturer PT Super Mitory Utama on Thursday after a sudden jump in its share price, an exchange official said.
"The exchange has suspended trading in the share as it had risen too sharp while the company had not informed us of any possible new corporate actions," the official told Reuters.
Super Mitory rose 575 rupiah to 2,500 rupiah on a thin volume of some 227,500 shares before being suspended at around 0715 GMT.
Brokers said the sudden rise in Super Mitory was partly due to market talk of a possible take-over. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
